options.name: accounting
options.description: Whether the RADIUS server is currently accepting accounting messages.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: authentication
options.description: Configure the RADIUS server state to accept or refuse authentication messages.

options.name: authservretry
options.description: Number of retry by the Citrix ADC before getting response from the RADIUS server.

options.name: authtimeout
options.description: Number of seconds the Citrix ADC waits for a response from the RADIUS server.

options.name: callingstationid
options.description: Send Calling-Station-ID of the client to the RADIUS server. IP Address of the client is sent as its Calling-Station-ID.

options.name: defaultauthenticationgroup
options.description: This is the default group that is chosen when the authentication succeeds in addition to extracted groups.

options.name: ipattributetype
options.description: Remote IP address attribute type in a RADIUS response.

options.name: ipvendorid
options.description: Vendor ID of the intranet IP attribute in the RADIUS response. NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that the attribute is not vendor encoded.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: messageauthenticator
options.description: Control whether the Message-Authenticator attribute is included in a RADIUS Access-Request packet.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the RADIUS action. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore character (_), and must contain only letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-), period (.) pound (#), space ( ), at (@), equals (=), colon (:), and underscore characters. Cannot be changed after the RADIUS action is added.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: passencoding
options.description: Encoding type for passwords in RADIUS packets that the Citrix ADC sends to the RADIUS server.

options.name: pwdattributetype
options.description: Vendor-specific password attribute type in a RADIUS response.

options.name: pwdvendorid
options.description: Vendor ID of the attribute, in the RADIUS response, used to extract the user password.

options.name: radattributetype
options.description: RADIUS attribute type, used for RADIUS group extraction.

options.name: radgroupseparator
options.description: RADIUS group separator string The group separator delimits group names within a RADIUS attribute for RADIUS group extraction.

options.name: radgroupsprefix
options.description: RADIUS groups prefix string. This groups prefix precedes the group names within a RADIUS attribute for RADIUS group extraction.

options.name: radkey
options.description: Key shared between the RADIUS server and the Citrix ADC. Required to allow the Citrix ADC to communicate with the RADIUS server.

options.name: radnasid
options.description: If configured, this string is sent to the RADIUS server as the Network Access Server ID (NASID).

options.name: radnasip
options.description: If enabled, the Citrix ADC IP address (NSIP) is sent to the RADIUS server as the  Network Access Server IP (NASIP) address. The RADIUS protocol defines the meaning and use of the NASIP address.

options.name: radvendorid
options.description: RADIUS vendor ID attribute, used for RADIUS group extraction.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: serverip
options.description: IP address assigned to the RADIUS server.

options.name: servername
options.description: RADIUS server name as a FQDN.  Mutually exclusive with RADIUS IP address.

options.name: serverport
options.description: Port number on which the RADIUS server listens for connections.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: targetlbvserver
options.description: If transport mode is TLS, specify the name of LB vserver to associate. The LB vserver needs to be of type TCP and service associated needs to be SSL_TCP

options.name: transport
options.description: Transport mode to RADIUS server.

options.name: tunnelendpointclientip
options.description: Send Tunnel Endpoint Client IP address to the RADIUS server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
